title: Establish repository truth for polymath-os
original_request: Inspect the actual polymath-os repository and produce an evidence-backed baseline before proposing implementation changes.
goal: Record default branch and base commit
Inventory actual modules, docs, tests and CI
Identify build/test commands only from repository evidence
non_goals: Do not change branch protection or secrets
constraints: No repository source sent to third-party services

assumptions.text: polymath-os is the root runtime repository

acceptance_criteria.statement: Repository inventory records each discovered path and commit context
acceptance_criteria.verification: Independent review of generated inventory against git tree

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every test/build command is linked to a source location or existing CI config
No source files or remote settings are changed
acceptance_criteria.verification: Compare git status and remote state before/after
